rules: Issuer must hold delegable rights for the requested scope.
Child rights and scope must be subsets; child expiry cannot exceed parent expiry.
Every ancestor must remain current and unrevoked.
Choice, branch edit, merge, deploy, exception and policy-edit rights are distinct.
Issuer retains delegation accountability; delegate remains accountable for actions.
delegation.revocation_behavior: Block subsequent affected actions; reconcile completed or partial effects rather than pretend retroactive rollback.

exceptions_and_appeals.exception_guard: Issuer is entitled for this rule, scope and exception type; constraint is exceptionable; exception is current and bound. No broader authority implied.
exceptions_and_appeals.exception_after_expiry: Before effects: deny. After effects: reconciliation/incident obligation, not automatic reversal.
exceptions_and_appeals.revision_rule: Append new decision with supersedes link; retain prior evidence, failed checks and rationale.
exceptions_and_appeals.cross_policy_no_arbiter: all affected entitled policy owners; no owner can waive an external obligation outside their jurisdiction

record_contract.kind: proposed field contract, not JSON Schema

decision_fields.name: id
decision_fields.meaning: Stable decision identity; revisions have separate IDs.

decision_fields.name: binding
decision_fields.meaning: All binding_fields; null material fields prevent actionable authorization.

decision_fields.name: evidence
decision_fields.meaning: Claims with IDs, producer identity, method/tool version, scope, evidence refs, target assumptions, time, status and derived_from; empty means not observed.

decision_fields.name: alternatives
decision_fields.meaning: IDs and separate feasibility/support/policy/intent states with reasons and source refs; illustrative states require explicit labeling.

decision_fields.name: choice
decision_fields.meaning: Selected alternative, chooser identity, grant reference and rationale; null is no actual choice.

decision_fields.name: authorization
decision_fields.meaning: Approver identity, grant chain refs, full binding, issued_at/expires_at, revocation ref, status and evidence ref; null means unauthorized.

decision_fields.name: execution
decision_fields.meaning: Actor, grant ref, input/output digests, effect scope, actual effects, timestamps, status and raw evidence refs.

decision_fields.name: verification
decision_fields.meaning: status plus check results binding criterion, verifier/tool, output, environment, coverage, independence and raw evidence ref.

decision_fields.name: acceptance
decision_fields.meaning: status, accountable owner, evidence_ref and exception refs; not a rewrite of verification.

decision_fields.name: conflict_ids
decision_fields.meaning: Conflict kinds requiring resolution, linked to applicable rules in an implemented record.

decision_fields.name: exception_refs
decision_fields.meaning: Granted exceptions only; empty does not indicate pending exceptions approved.

decision_fields.name: appeal
decision_fields.meaning: Requester, affected decision/rule refs, reason, routed owner, status, resolution and evidence refs.

decision_fields.name: llm_involvement
decision_fields.meaning: Observed status, advisory scope and prohibited escalation; production records should link model/run evidence when present.

decision_fields.name: supersedes
decision_fields.meaning: Prior decision revision retained for lineage.

provenance_mapping.actedOnBehalfOf: descriptive delegation lineage; requires a separately verified grant

record_contract.event_store: Append consequential transitions and supersession; redact sensitive payloads with explicit redaction metadata and protected evidence references. Record missing events; do not claim completeness from logs alone.
